segments.text: Rahul Verma: The Redis-based rate limiter is complete and deployed. The token bucket algorithm implementation passed all load tests.
Nisha Patel: The NLP pipeline is complete. Entity extraction with spaCy and co-reference resolution are working. The NLP pipeline integration task is closed.
Priya Sharma: We decided to use pgvector extension for vector similarity search in PostgreSQL. This decision is linked to the earlier PostgreSQL adoption decision.
Kiran Das: The Kubernetes pod startup issue is resolved. I optimized Docker images from 1.2GB to 450MB using multi-stage builds. The Kubernetes cluster deadline of September 15th is on track.
